title: CiteGuard: Faithful Citation Attribution for LLMs via Retrieval-Augmented Validation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical accuracy and faithfulness of citation attribution in scientific writing for LLMs. While it includes a section on 'Ethical considerations' and uses the word 'faithful' in the title, it does so in the context of bibliographic grounding and factual accuracy rather than religion, spiritual faith, morals, or ethics.
